n609cc0b94d8.s: Under the AP Reorganisation Act, 2014, the Krishna River Management Board (KRMB) has its headquarters in:
n609cc0b94d8.x: KRMB has its headquarters in Andhra Pradesh; it is the Godavari River Management Board that is in Telangana.

nap-geography-12-7.s: The Vamsadhara river meets the Bay of Bengal at:
nap-geography-12-7.x: The Vamsadhara meets the sea at Kalingapatnam; Mopasu Bandar is the Nagavali's mouth.

nd431e058094.s: Which river link is already functioning in Andhra Pradesh through the Pattiseema scheme?
nd431e058094.x: The Godavari–Krishna link works through Pattiseema; Vamsadhara–Nagavali is only about 73% complete.

nap-geography-16-3.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Pattiseema Lift Irrigation Scheme?
o: It is a Godavari–Krishna inter-basin transfer
It pumps Godavari water into the Polavaram Right Main Canal
It delivers Godavari water to the Krishna above Prakasam Barrage
It carries Godavari water through the Polavaram Left Main Canal to the Yeleru
nap-geography-16-3.x: Pattiseema uses the Polavaram Right Main Canal to reach the Krishna above Prakasam Barrage; the Left Main Canal route to the Yeleru is the Purushothapatnam scheme.

nap-geography-16-5.s: Which of the following projects carries water to Chennai as part of the Telugu Ganga?
nap-geography-16-5.x: Kandaleru is the Telugu Ganga link to Chennai; Veligonda takes Srisailam water through twin tunnels to Nallamala Sagar.

n70cfddce939.s: After rising in Maharashtra, the Krishna River next flows through which State?
n70cfddce939.x: The Krishna traverses Maharashtra, Karnataka, Telangana and Andhra Pradesh, in that order.

n48d1bcb341b.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the main hazards of the regions of Andhra Pradesh?
o: Coastal Andhra faces cyclones, storm surge, floods and coastal erosion
Rayalaseema and southern Prakasam face chronic drought and groundwater depletion
The main hazards of the inland plains are cyclones and storm surge
The inland plains face rising heat waves
n48d1bcb341b.x: The main hazard of the inland plains is rising heat waves; cyclones and storm surge are the hazards of Coastal Andhra.

na793dc15c82.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about Swaraj Abhiyan v. Union of India (2016)?
o: It was decided by the Supreme Court
It directed that the drought manual be updated
It directed the setting up of the National Disaster Mitigation Fund
It directed the setting up of a National Drought Insurance Fund
na793dc15c82.x: The Supreme Court ordered the drought manual updated and the National Disaster Mitigation Fund set up, not a drought insurance fund.

na8c731c5175.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about flood-management measures?
o: Detention basins are a non-structural measure
Flood forecasting and warning is a non-structural measure
Flood insurance is a non-structural measure
na8c731c5175.x: Detention basins are a structural measure, like embankments; forecasting and insurance are non-structural.

ndisaster-management-12-4.s:
Consider the following statements about hazard-mitigation measures:
1. Embankments, dams and channel improvement are flood-mitigation measures.
2. Check dams, farm ponds and irrigation are drought-mitigation measures.
3. Check dams, farm ponds and irrigation are the main landslide-mitigation measures.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
ndisaster-management-12-4.x: Statements 1 and 2 are correct. Landslides are met with retaining walls and slope stabilisation; check dams and farm ponds are drought measures.

nindian-geography-50-5.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Himalayan forests?
o: Alpine forests occur at about 3,000–4,900 m
The coniferous belt below is the reason alpine forests occur higher up
Coniferous forests occur on the slopes at about 1,500–3,000 m
Alpine forests lie above the coniferous belt
nindian-geography-50-5.x: Both altitude facts are true, but the coniferous belt at lower altitude does not explain why alpine forests occur higher up.

n9d066397332.s: By mangrove-cover area, Andhra Pradesh ranks second in:
n9d066397332.x: AP is second only on the east coast; by ISFR area it ranks behind West Bengal, Gujarat and Andaman & Nicobar in India.

na175b6504da.s: TRIFED was established in 1987 under which Act?
na175b6504da.x: TRIFED was set up in 1987 under the Multi-State Co-operative Societies Act, 1984, and works under the Ministry of Tribal Affairs.

new.s: Which river has the longest course within Andhra Pradesh?
new.x: 536 km of the Penna's 597 km lie in AP; the Godavari is the longest river flowing through AP by total length.

new.s: Among peninsular rivers, which basin is the second largest after the Godavari?
new.x: The peninsular basin order is Godavari > Krishna > Mahanadi.

new.s: Which river is shared by Andhra Pradesh and Tamil Nadu only?
new.x: The Araniar basin lies in AP and Tamil Nadu; the Palar also covers Karnataka, Budameru is shared with Telangana and Bahuda with Odisha.

new.s: The Mahendratanaya river rises in which hills?
new.x: The Mahendratanaya rises in the Mahendragiri hills; Madugula gives the Machkund, Sinkaram the Sabari and Anantagiri the Gosthani.

new.s: Which is the largest tributary of the Godavari by drainage area?
new.x: The Pranhita is the Godavari's largest tributary by drainage area.

new.s: Which of the following is NOT a left-bank tributary of the Godavari?
new.x: The Manjira is a right-bank tributary, with the Pravara and Manair; Purna, Pranhita, Indravati and Sabari are left-bank.

new.s: The Sileru joins the Godavari system as a tributary of which river?
new.x: The Sabari, with its tributary the Sileru, joins the Godavari in AP.

new.s: Which is the longest tributary of the Krishna?
new.x: The Bhima is the Krishna's longest tributary; the Tungabhadra is its largest.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about the tributaries of the Krishna:
1. The Bhima is a left-bank tributary.
2. The Tungabhadra is a right-bank tributary.
3. The Musi is a right-bank tributary.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: The Bhima and Musi are left-bank tributaries and the Tungabhadra is right-bank, so statement 3 is wrong.

new.s: The Tungabhadra joins the Krishna at:
new.x: The Tungabhadra joins the Krishna at Sangameswaram in Kurnool; Antarvedi is a Godavari mouth.

new.s: The Cheyyeru, a tributary of the Penna, is formed by the union of:
new.x: The Cheyyeru is formed by the Bahuda and Pincha; the Veda and Avathi form the Vedavathi.

new.s: The Chitravathi joins the Penna at:
new.x: The Chitravathi joins at Gandikota; the Cheyyeru joins at Gundlamada and the Kundu at Adinimmayapalli.

new.s: Which is the biggest river born in the Eastern Ghats?
new.x: The Vamsadhara is the biggest river born in the Eastern Ghats; it rises in the Jayapur hills of Odisha.

new.s: Asia's first rubber dam is on which river?
new.x: The Janjavathi, a tributary of the Nagavali, has Asia's first rubber dam.

new.s: The Swarnamukhi river rises near:
new.x: The Swarnamukhi rises near Pakala; Sadasivakonda is the Arani's source.

new.s: Into which lake does the Tammileru drain?
new.x: The Tammileru, on the Krishna–West Godavari boundary, drains into Kolleru Lake.

new.s: The Krishna divides into its two delta branches at:
new.x: The Krishna splits at Puligadda, 64 km below Vijayawada; the Godavari splits at Dowleswaram.

new.s: Bhavani Island, near Prakasam Barrage, lies in which river?
new.x: Bhavani Island is in the Krishna at Vijayawada, near Prakasam Barrage.

new.s: How many mouths does the Godavari delta have?
new.x: The Godavari splits into 2 main distributaries, Gautami and Vasishta, and its delta has 7 mouths.

new.s: The Thotapalli project is built on which river?
new.x: Thotapalli is on the Nagavali in Parvathipuram Manyam; the Gotta Barrage is on the Vamsadhara.

new.s: The Gotta Barrage in Srikakulam is built across the:
new.x: The Gotta Barrage is on the Vamsadhara; Thotapalli is on the Nagavali.

new.s: The Pulichintala project on the Krishna lies in which district?
new.x: Pulichintala is in Palnadu (erstwhile Guntur); Srisailam is in Nandyal.

new.s: The Prakasam Barrage on the Krishna is located at:
new.x: Prakasam Barrage is at Vijayawada; the Sir Arthur Cotton Barrage is at Rajamahendravaram.

new.s: The Sir Arthur Cotton (Dowleswaram) Barrage on the Godavari dates from:
new.x: Cotton's Godavari work at Dowleswaram dates from 1852.

new.s: Vani Vilasa Sagar (Marikanive), the first dam of M. Visvesvaraya, is on which river?
new.x: Vani Vilasa Sagar is on the Vedavathi and was Visvesvaraya's first dam.

new.s: The 14th-century Vijayanagara tank Anantaraja Sagar is in which district?
new.x: Anantaraja Sagar (Porumamilla) is in YSR Kadapa; the Cumbum tank is in Prakasam.

new.s: The installed hydropower capacity designed for Polavaram is:
new.x: Polavaram is designed for 194.6 TMC storage, 7.20 lakh acres and 960 MW.

new.s: How much Godavari water is Polavaram designed to divert to the Krishna?
new.x: Polavaram is to divert 80 TMC to the Krishna; 194.6 TMC is its storage.

new.s: The Godavari–Penna link Phase-I involves a lift of how many stages?
new.x: Godavari–Penna Phase-I is a 73 TMC, five-stage lift scheme.

new.s: The Handri-Neeva scheme draws water from:
new.x: Handri-Neeva lifts water from the Srisailam backwaters for Kurnool, Anantapur, Kadapa and Chittoor.

new.s: The KC Canal, headed at Sunkesula on the Tungabhadra, serves which districts?
new.x: The KC Canal from Sunkesula serves Kurnool and Kadapa.

new.s: The Galeru-Nagari scheme diverts Krishna floodwaters mainly to:
new.x: Galeru-Nagari carries Krishna floodwaters to Kadapa, Chittoor and Nellore.

new.s: Under the Telugu Ganga arrangement, how much water did each of the three Krishna basin States give for Chennai?
new.x: Maharashtra, Karnataka and AP gave 5 tmc each, a total of 15 tmc.

new.s: The Brijesh Kumar Tribunal (KWDT-II) on the Krishna gave its report in:
new.x: KWDT-II reported in 2010 with a further report in 2013; 1976 was the Bachawat award.

new.s: The Babli barrage, the subject of a 2013 Supreme Court verdict, is built by Maharashtra on the:
new.x: Babli barrage is on the Godavari, upstream of Sriramsagar.

new.s: The Bachawat Tribunal assessed the Krishna's total water at 75% dependability as:
new.x: KWDT-I assessed 2,060 TMC at 75% dependability, of which AP's share was 811 TMC.

new.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
new.x: The Bachawat award came in 1976; the Vamsadhara final award was 2017, GWDT's award 1980, and Brijesh Kumar is a Krishna tribunal.

new.s: Andhra Pradesh objects to which of the following projects of Telangana?
new.x: AP objects to Kaleshwaram and Palamuru-Rangareddy; Pattiseema, Polavaram and Banakacherla are AP projects Telangana objects to.

new.s: Which is the hottest place in Andhra Pradesh?
new.x: Rentachintala in Palnadu is the hottest place; Lambasingi is the coldest.

new.s: The heat-wave belt of Andhra Pradesh comprises:
new.x: Palnadu, Kurnool and Anantapur form the heat-wave belt, peaking in May–June.

new.s: The climate of Rayalaseema is classed as:
new.x: Rayalaseema is semi-arid, while coastal Andhra is humid and cyclone-exposed.

new.s: The normal annual rainfall of Andhra Pradesh is about:
new.x: Normal rain is 574.7 mm (SW) + 285.3 mm (NE), about 860 mm a year.

new.s: River floods in Andhra Pradesh come mainly during the:
new.x: River floods come mainly in the SW monsoon; most cyclones come in October–December.

new.s: In the 2026 El Niño year, AP's south-west monsoon deficit (1 June–25 August) was about:
new.x: The 2026 SW-monsoon deficit was 51.2%, with all 28 districts deficient.

new.s: How many agro-climatic zones does Andhra Pradesh have under ANGRAU?
new.x: AP has 6 agro-climatic zones, each with an ANGRAU Regional Agricultural Research Station.

new.s: The Regional Agricultural Research Station of the Scarce Rainfall zone is at:
new.x: The Scarce Rainfall zone's RARS is at Nandyal; Tirupati serves the Southern zone.

new.s: Which of the following agro-climatic zone – RARS headquarters pairs is correctly matched?
new.x: Godavari zone is at Maruteru; North Coastal is Anakapalle, Krishna is Lam and High Altitude and Tribal is Chintapalle.

new.s: Which districts entirely form the Scarce Rainfall agro-climatic zone?
new.x: The Scarce Rainfall zone covers the whole of Anantapur and Kurnool.

new.s: Which is the lowest-rainfall district of Andhra Pradesh?
new.x: Anantapur, in rain-shadow Rayalaseema, is the lowest-rainfall district.

new.s: Areas receiving less than ____ of rain a year are classed as chronically drought prone.
new.x: Under 750 mm a year is chronically drought prone; 750–1,125 mm is drought prone.

new.s: The 100-day water plan of April 2026 was launched at:
new.x: The 100-day water plan was launched at Yadiki in Anantapur on 6 April 2026.

new.s: The NDMA Drought Guidelines were issued in:
new.x: The NDMA Drought Guidelines date from 2010; the Manual for Drought Management was revised in 2016.

new.s: Meteorological drought is triggered when seasonal rainfall falls below what share of normal?
new.x: The meteorological drought trigger is seasonal rain below 75% of normal.

new.s: About what share of Andhra Pradesh is vulnerable to tropical storms and related hazards?
new.x: About 44% of the State is vulnerable to tropical storms and related hazards.

new.s: The Flood Hazard Atlas of Andhra Pradesh was prepared by:
new.x: NRSC built the Flood Hazard Atlas from multi-date satellite data of 2000–2020.

new.s: After the December 2024 remeasurement, Andhra Pradesh's coastline ranks ____ in India.
new.x: At 1,053.07 km AP is third, after Gujarat and Tamil Nadu.

new.s: An IMD Cyclone Warning Centre in Andhra Pradesh is located at:
new.x: Visakhapatnam has one of IMD's seven Cyclone Warning Centres.

new.s: Which districts are the most exposed to cyclones in Andhra Pradesh?
new.x: Nellore and Srikakulam are the most exposed districts.

new.s: Cyclone Titli (2018) made landfall near:
new.x: Titli crossed near Palasa in Srikakulam in October 2018.

new.s: Cyclone Phethai (December 2018) struck near:
new.x: Phethai struck the Kakinada/Yanam coast.

new.s: Which two cyclones made landfall near Bapatla?
new.x: Laila (2010) and Michaung (2023) both made landfall near Bapatla.

new.s: The name of Cyclone Hudhud (2014) was given by:
new.x: Hudhud, which hit Visakhapatnam in October 2014, was named by Oman.

new.s: Which of the following cyclone – landfall pairs is correctly matched?
new.x: Phailin crossed at Gopalpur in Odisha; Hudhud hit Visakhapatnam, Montha Kakinada and Titli Palasa.

new.s: How many multipurpose cyclone shelters did NCRMP Phase I build in Andhra Pradesh?
new.x: NCRMP-I built 219 shelters in AP and 316 in Odisha.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about the National Cyclone Risk Mitigation Project (NCRMP):
1. Phase I covered Andhra Pradesh and Odisha.
2. Phase I built more multipurpose cyclone shelters in Andhra Pradesh than in Odisha.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Phase I covered AP and Odisha, but it built 219 shelters in AP against 316 in Odisha.

new.s: According to the NDMA Cyclone Guidelines, which is a structural cyclone-mitigation measure?
new.x: Storm-surge barriers are structural; mangroves, bio-shields and sand-dune restoration are nature-based.

new.s: The Polavaram spillway has how many radial gates?
new.x: The Polavaram spillway has 48 radial gates for a probable maximum flood of about 50 lakh cusecs.

new.s: The Centre supports States' flood management through:
new.x: Flood management is a State subject; the Centre helps through FMBAP.

new.s: The Indian Tsunami Early Warning Centre is at INCOIS in:
new.x: INCOIS, Hyderabad opened the Indian Tsunami Early Warning Centre in October 2007.

new.s: Andhra Pradesh's Dial 112 (ERSS) control centre is at:
new.x: ERSS 112 went live in AP on 19 February 2019; its PSAP control centre is at Mangalagiri.

new.s: Which is the biggest forest block of Andhra Pradesh?
new.x: Nallamala is the biggest forest of AP; the Gundlakamma forest zone is part of it.

new.s: Papikonda National Park has which forest type?
new.x: Papikonda is moist deciduous; Seshachalam is dry deciduous.

new.s: The Coringa tidal forests lie at:
o: The mouths of the Godavari and Krishna
new.x: Coringa tidal forests are at the Godavari–Krishna mouths, not in Seshachalam–Nallamala.

new.s: The MISHTI mangrove programme was launched in:
new.x: MISHTI was announced in the 2023–24 Budget and launched on 5 June 2023, not 2019.

new.s: As per ISFR 2023, Andhra Pradesh's forest cover is about what share of its area?
new.x: AP's forest cover is 30,084.96 sq km, about 18.47%; 22.86% is its recorded forest area.

new.s: In ISFR 2023, Andhra Pradesh's recorded forest area ranks ____ in India.
new.x: AP's recorded forest area of 37,258 sq km (22.86%) is 8th in India.

new.s: Which district recorded the largest forest-cover gain in Andhra Pradesh in ISFR 2023?
new.x: Vizianagaram gained most (35.35 sq km), then Nellore (17.77).

new.s: ISFR 2023 puts India's forest and tree cover at about:
new.x: India's forest and tree cover is 8,27,357 sq km, 25.17% of its area.

new.s: Very Dense Forest has a canopy density of:
new.x: VDF is 70% and above; MDF 40–70%; OF 10–40%.

new.s: In ISFR 2019, which density class was the largest in Andhra Pradesh?
new.x: In ISFR 2019 MDF (13,938 sq km) was slightly larger than OF; by ISFR 2023 Open Forest became the largest.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about forest density classes in Andhra Pradesh:
1. Open Forest has a canopy density of 10–40%.
2. Scrub is counted as forest cover.
3. Open Forest was the largest class in ISFR 2023.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Statements 1 and 3 are correct; scrub is not counted as forest cover.

new.s: Protected Forests make up about what share of Andhra Pradesh's notified forest area?
new.x: Reserved 85.8%, Protected 13.6%, Unclassed 0.6%.

new.s: Which pre-2022 district of Andhra Pradesh had the highest forest percentage?
new.x: Visakhapatnam had the highest forest percentage; Kadapa had the largest forest area.

new.s: Which pre-2022 district had the lowest forest area in Andhra Pradesh?
new.x: Krishna had the lowest forest area and percentage; Anantapur had the lowest rainfall.

new.s: The 2026 fire-prone forest zones of Andhra Pradesh lay in:
new.x: Horsley Hills, Mallappa Konda and the Somala belt in Chittoor and Annamayya were the 2026 fire-prone zones.

new.s: Red sanders is endemic to which ranges?
new.x: Red sanders is endemic to the Seshachalam, Palakonda and Veligonda ranges.

new.s: Red sanders is listed under which Schedule of the Wildlife (Protection) Act, 1972?
new.x: Red sanders is in Schedule IV of the WPA 1972, CITES Appendix II, and is IUCN Endangered.

new.s: Bamboo and sandalwood in Andhra Pradesh come mainly from:
o: Northern Eastern Ghats moist hill forests
new.x: Bamboo and sandalwood come from the moist hill forests of the northern Eastern Ghats.

new.s: Which body buys minor forest produce from tribals in Andhra Pradesh?
new.x: GCC, Visakhapatnam buys MFP; TRIFED runs MSP for MFP and APFDC exports red sanders.

new.s: The annual value of non-timber forest produce (NTFP) in Andhra Pradesh is:
new.x: NTFP is worth over ₹500 crore a year; ₹32.81 crore was the 2023-24 forest revenue.

new.s: The red sanders wood bank of Andhra Pradesh is at:
new.x: Red sanders bank is at Tirupati; teak at Kapavaram, bamboo at Rajamahendravaram, central at Dowleswaram.

new.s: APFDC is the largest grower among PSUs in India of:
new.x: APFDC is India's largest Eucalyptus grower among PSUs, with 33,584 ha.

new.s: APFDC coffee plantations are located in:
new.x: APFDC coffee is in Visakhapatnam and East Godavari; cashew is on the Guntur–Prakasam–Nellore coast and elsewhere.

new.s: The Trees Outside Forests in India (TOFI) programme is run by MoEFCC with:
new.x: TOFI is a five-year USAID–MoEFCC programme launched on 8 September 2022.

new.s: Andhra Pradesh is one of how many States under the TOFI programme?
new.x: AP is one of 7 TOFI States, with Assam, Haryana, Odisha, Rajasthan, Tamil Nadu and UP.

new.s: Forest land diverted in Andhra Pradesh under the Van Adhiniyam, 1980 up to 2017-18 was about:
new.x: Diversion up to 2017-18 was 26,924.34 ha (27,641.252 ha in all later).

new.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the forests of Andhra Pradesh?
o: The forests are predominantly tropical deciduous
Tropical thorn forest is the largest forest type by area
Nallamala is the biggest forest block
Thorn and mangrove forests cover smaller areas
new.x: The largest forest type by area is tropical dry deciduous, not thorn.

new.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about forest extremes among pre-2022 districts of AP?
o: Krishna had the lowest forest percentage
East Godavari had the highest forest cover in ISFR 2019
Visakhapatnam had the largest forest area
YSR Kadapa had the largest forest area
new.x: YSR Kadapa had the largest forest area; Visakhapatnam had the highest forest percentage.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about red sanders:
1. It is listed as Endangered by the IUCN.
2. It is listed in Appendix I of CITES.
3. Thermal-imaging drones are used against its smuggling in Seshachalam.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Statements 1 and 3 are correct; red sanders is in CITES Appendix II, not Appendix I.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about forest agencies in Andhra Pradesh:
1. TRIFED is the nodal agency for MSP for minor forest produce.
2. CAMPA funds compensatory afforestation through an Annual Plan of Operation.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Both are correct: TRIFED runs MSP for MFP and CAMPA funds compensatory afforestation via an Annual Plan of Operation.

new.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Manual for Drought Management, 2016?
o: It treats rainfall deviation and dry spells as mandatory indicators
It was issued by the Ministry of Agriculture
It treats crop sowing as a mandatory indicator
new.x: Crop sowing is an impact indicator; the mandatory indicators are rainfall deviation and dry spells.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about the north-east monsoon:
1. Tamil Nadu receives the maximum north-east monsoon rain.
2. The Gujarat coast receives north-east monsoon rain.
3. Andhra Pradesh receives about one-third of its rain in October–December.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Statements 1 and 3 are correct; the north-east monsoon does not bring rain to the Gujarat coast.

new.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the APSDMA?
o: It is chaired by the Chief Secretary
It functions under the DM Act 2005 and the AP DM Rules 2007
It is the chief nodal agency for disaster management in AP
new.x: APSDMA is chaired by the Chief Minister.

new.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about cyclones that affected Andhra Pradesh?
o: Phailin (2013) made landfall in Andhra Pradesh
The 1977 Diviseema cyclone caused the maximum loss of life
new.x: Phailin made landfall at Gopalpur in Odisha; only north coastal AP was affected.

new.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Purushothapatnam Lift Irrigation Scheme?
o: It uses the Polavaram Left Main Canal
It lifts Godavari water into the Polavaram Right Main Canal
It carries water to the Yeleru for Visakhapatnam and North Andhra
new.x: Purushothapatnam uses the Left Main Canal; the Right Main Canal is used by Pattiseema.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about the Polavaram Project:
1. It is an earth-cum-rockfill dam on the Godavari.
2. It is a National Project under Section 89 of the AP Reorganisation Act, 2014.
3. It was first planned as Ramapada Sagar by Dr. K.L. Rao.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Statements 1 and 3 are correct; National Project status is under Section 90, not 89.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about the Vamsadhara:
1. It enters Andhra Pradesh at Pathapatnam in Srikakulam.
2. Its tributary Mahendratanaya is shared by Odisha and Andhra Pradesh.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Both are correct: the Vamsadhara enters AP at Pathapatnam and its tributary Mahendratanaya is shared by Odisha and AP.

new.s: Which of the following project – river pairs is INCORRECTLY matched?
new.x: Kandaleru is a Penna-basin balancing reservoir of the Telugu Ganga (Krishna water), not a Godavari project.
